cohort: 440 pregnant women who gave birth at Ordu Private Umut Hospital between January 1st and December 31st, 2022
finding: The study found that maternal age, pre-pregnancy weight, delivery weight, and previous cesarean section were significantly associated with newborn birth weight, length, head circumference, and APGAR score.
mod_finding: Women with previous cesarean sections had lower newborn APGAR scores.
